seniorLeadership.name: Ava Langridge
seniorLeadership.quote: I started this movement because I believed in the power of our youth's voices and knew the impact we could have. Systemic change needs to happen, and we are taking the necessary steps.

seniorLeadership.name: Caitlin McLean
seniorLeadership.quote: Education is essential for equipping people with the tools required to address climate-related issues facing them today, but also for empowering and uniting communities to build a better and more sustainable future.

seniorLeadership.name: Yumna Ramsingh
seniorLeadership.quote: Understanding a problem is the first step to dismantling it. OY4C's mission equips our youth with the context and knowledge they need to combat a problem as complex as the climate crisis.

seniorLeadership.name: Michelle Alinndra Annabeth Chandra
seniorLeadership.quote: Environmental problems are daily life problems, and awareness alone doesn't change anything.

seniorLeadership.name: Deanna Gracia
seniorLeadership.quote: Communities are the heartbeat of climate action. I believe in OY4C's mission to harness the power of climate education to inspire collective leadership and action in local communities to create a future that's both sustainable and just.

seniorLeadership.name: Sasha (Alexandra) Krištofovičová
seniorLeadership.quote: Climate education is for everyone, and is fundamental in shaping future generations that care for our planet and conserve its resources. I joined OY4C because I am proud to promote its important message and drive change for a healthy planet and people!

seniorLeadership.name: Aana Shenai
seniorLeadership.quote: I joined OY4C because I wanted to work with other young people to educate our community about environmental issues. As climate change will inevitably affect our generation the most, I believe broadcasting youth voices and contributing to youth-led activist organizations are crucial in moving towards a more sustainable future.

seniorLeadership.name: Queen (Elizabeth) Chukwu
seniorLeadership.quote: I believe that climate education is key to real climate action, and OY4C's mission speaks to that. Getting to support it through storytelling and media strategy feels like the perfect meeting point of two things I really care about.
